notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch (curl, desktop UA) for HTML; every genuine PLP renders its total server-side as 'Affiche N resultats sur M'/'M elements' (French equivalent of the DE 'N Produkte' pattern), so no Playwright was needed. robots.txt (global, ikea.com/robots.txt; fr-FR has no separate file) checked, no Claude-specific disallow. Discovery: homepage embedded nav/footer links (found 'noel-wt001' and 'eclairage-saisonnier-14971' directly), the FR category sitemap (sitemaps/cat-fr-FR_1.xml, 1075 URLs, full-text scanned for noel/halloween/paques/diwali/valentin/thanksgiving/nouvel-an/eid/festi/saison/automne/ete/hiver/printemps and more), and the same cross-market numeric category ids already confirmed on IKEA UK (se92) and IKEA DE (se107) - re-verified independently against FR's own titles, breadcrumbs and product samples rather than assumed. Every cross-market id tested (49149-49160, 49227/49229/49232/49233, 53254-53256, 700321/326-329/552/570/606/668, 47706) resolved on ikea.com/fr/fr with FR-language slugs and FR-specific counts (not copied from UK/DE), confirming FR shares the same underlying seasonal taxonomy while its own assortment/counts differ. 'Christmas' (wt001) and 'Christmas Food' (epicerie-de-noel-49227, own count 17 roughly equal to its 3 children 11+5+3=19) kept as grouping rows per rule 9, not double-counted. Dropped as 0-current-products (page loads, 'Aucun produit ne correspond a votre selection', matching UK/DE's identical finding for the same cross-market ids): sapins-de-noel-49158 (Christmas trees), couronnes-de-noel-49159 (Christmas wreaths), decorations-de-sapin-de-noel-49155 (tree ornaments/baubles). 'Fetes saisonnieres' (700321, Seasonal Celebrations, 145 products) kept as its own flagged grouping row exactly as UK/DE did for the same node - it mixes Christmas, Halloween, Easter, Midsummer and Crayfish Party under one PLP; its per-occasion children are the rows already listed under their own holiday categories above/below, not duplicated here. 'L'ete suedois' (700329) is titled generically ('Swedish summer') but its own intro copy explicitly says 'En Suede, le solstice d'ete est un evenement majeur et une excuse parfaite pour faire la fete' (the summer solstice = Midsummer is a major event) - classified Midsummer per the site's own on-page copy, consistent with UK 'Swedish Midsummer'/DE 'Midsommar in Schweden' for the same id. VINTERFINT (vinterfest-collection-47706) and TJARLEK (collection-tjaerlek-700606) each resolve to a genuine, currently very small live PLP (1 real product each, confirmed by product alt text: a VINTERFINT Christmas rug and a Paques/Easter paper item respectively) rather than a 0-item or not-yet-launched page (DE's VINTERFINT was dropped as not-live; FR's is live with 1 item) - kept as rows per the non-zero convention, each flagged for the unusually low count. Excluded as non-seasonal cross-link (rule 5/6 - generic seasonal-style category, not tied to a named occasion, filed under Lighting not under Noel, meta description says 'toute l'annee'/all year round): 'Eclairage saisonnier interieur et exterieur' (14971, 46 products, breadcrumb Luminaires & eclairage). Excluded as marketing/navigation page (no product-grid total, pure hub): 'Inspiration saisonniere et idees cadeaux' (inspirations-saisonnieres-shops) and 'Laissez entrer le printemps' (visual-navigation spring landing page found inside the TJARLEK collections JSON, not a category). Checked and confirmed NOT present anywhere in the FR category sitemap, homepage nav, or Collections hub (keyword scan: valentin/saint-valentin, diwali/deepavali, eid, nouvel-an/jour-de-l'an, thanksgiving/action-de-grace, holi, rakhi/raksha-bandhan): Valentine's Day, Diwali, Eid, New Year, Thanksgiving, Holi, Raksha Bandhan and other Indian festivals, St Patrick's Day, Black Friday as its own category, Mother's/Father's Day as seasonal categories, Easter as a standalone (non-Sweden-branded) French category (Easter only exists FR-side via the Swedish-branded 'Paques suedois' page and the TJARLEK collection). All qty are the server-rendered PLP total ('Affiche N resultats sur M' / 'M elements'), each cross-checked against its own page's canonical URL, title and breadcrumb to place it correctly in the hierarchy.
